title: Privacy Policy | Lalitpur Financial Advisory Nepal
metaDescription: Our commitment to protecting your personal and corporate financial data in compliance with the Individual Privacy Act 2075 of Nepal.
directAnswer: Lalitpur Financial Advisory is committed to safeguarding the privacy and confidentiality of our clients' corporate and personal financial information in accordance with the Individual Privacy Act 2075 of Nepal. This policy explains what information we collect, how it is secured, and your rights.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Legal Desk

sections.contentHtml: We collect only information voluntarily submitted through our consultation booking forms (name, telephone/WhatsApp, email, service interest) and financial records provided under formal advisory contracts. We never request banking passwords, OTPs, or credit card numbers.

Client records are utilized exclusively to evaluate and deliver contracted financial consultancy services. We do not sell, rent, or trade client information to any third party for marketing or advertising purposes.

In compliance with the Individual Privacy Act 2075 (वैयक्तिक गोपनीयता ऐन, २०७५), client digital files are stored using encrypted protocols with restricted access limited strictly to assigned financial consultants.

cta.headline: Questions About Our Data Protection Practices?
cta.subtext: Contact our compliance officer at privacy@lalitpurfinancial.com.np.
